summary: The fund is an actively managed exchange-traded fund (“ETF”) that seeks to achieve its investment objective through a combination of equity securities and total return swaps. Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the fund’s net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) will be invested in equity securities of large cap companies and in U.S. large-cap ETFs.
